caption: The drawing depicts a single turtle positioned centrally on a blank, cream-colored background. The turtle features a dark brown, domed shell with lighter brown and beige patterns forming concentric shapes and geometric designs on each scute. The turtle's head, limbs, and tail are visible, all of which are colored in shades of brown, matching the darker tones of the shell. Its limbs are outstretched, showing claws on each foot. The drawing is rendered with fine detail and realistic proportions, and the artist's signature, "N. Amantea," is located on the lower right side of the image. There are no additional objects or background elements present.
title: Door Stop
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
